decision: Run one frozen report-only feasibility screen for a point-in-time OI-conditioned forced-deleveraging event. Do not tune, train, route, size, or change v51 from this revision.
why_now: The existing flow-exhaustion reversion family was development-falsified without OI evidence. A newly reconciled immutable live-event archive contains synchronized OI, public trades, and L2 books for BTC and SOL, which materially changes the observable mechanism without changing the rejected strategy's result.

prior_hypothesis_disposition.result: 16 trades over 177 days, nominal net -191.91 USD, PF 0.284; both sides and both assets lost
prior_hypothesis_disposition.rule: Do not retune or relabel the rejected flow-exhaustion contract. OI contraction is a new required input and this screen is a distinct feasibility diagnostic.

frozen_scope.gap_policy: Any missing common OI, trade, or book minute ends a segment and resets all rolling history. No interpolation or bridging is allowed.
frozen_scope.oi_timestamp_contract: activeAssetCtx has no exchange timestamp; use received_ts_ns as the causal ordering clock and disclose this source limitation
frozen_scope.causal_availability_clock: Use received_ts_ns to assign OI, public trades, and L2 snapshots to decision minutes; exchange timestamps remain provenance only and cannot make a later-received row available earlier.
frozen_scope.selection_policy: The development segment is evaluated first. Confirmation remains unread unless the development feasibility criterion passes.

frozen_signal.price_shock: absolute public-trade close-to-close return must be at least 13 bps and at least the prior-only rolling 90th percentile over 288 contiguous bars
frozen_signal.oi_contraction: five-minute open-interest percentage change must be at most -0.05% and at most the prior-only rolling 10th percentile over 288 contiguous bars
frozen_signal.forced_side: the sign of the five-minute price shock
frozen_signal.terminal_trade_exhaustion: final completed one-minute aggressor notional imbalance has the opposite sign from the forced side
frozen_signal.terminal_book_replenishment: last causally available top-ten L2 imbalance before bar close has the opposite sign from the forced side
frozen_signal.eligible_event: price shock and OI contraction are both true; exhaustion is reported as a frozen subgroup and cannot be inferred after outcomes
frozen_signal.overlap_policy: after an event, suppress additional events for the same symbol until the 15-minute primary horizon resolves

frozen_outcome.entry: first complete L2 quote at or after the next minute boundary; buy at ask for reversion after a down shock and sell at bid after an up shock
frozen_outcome.exit: first complete L2 quote at or after the primary horizon; long exits at bid and short exits at ask
frozen_outcome.primary_return: opposite-shock executable gross return in bps

development_feasibility_criterion.required_symbol_consistency: positive mean primary return for both BTC and SOL
development_feasibility_criterion.technical_requirements: zero incomplete entry or exit quotes, zero crossed books, zero bridged data gaps, and exact point-in-time OI availability
development_feasibility_criterion.failure_behavior: Reject this exact contract or label it data-insufficient. Do not lower thresholds, change direction, select another horizon, add a model, or open confirmation after observing failure.

ml_policy.rule: Do not fit Ridge, LightGBM, or any allocator unless the frozen exhausted subgroup clears the gross 2x nominal-cost hurdle and technical requirements. A model cannot rescue a negative base signal.

confidence.data_availability: high for the declared contiguous segments
confidence.mechanism: low until the frozen event distribution is measured

falsifier: Reject the evidence if database identity changes during evaluation, any feature uses information received after its decision, a gap is bridged, OI is missing or timestamp-ambiguous, execution quotes are incomplete, confirmation is read before development passes, or reported economics differ when recomputed from immutable event rows.
